who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), lane W1 watch-1114 (outside reads answered by stamp)
where: crates/blaze-vfs/src/outside.rs, crates/base-db/src/lib.rs, crates/blaze-usercode/src/inputs.rs, crates/blaze-host/src/outside.rs, crates/blaze-cargo/src/serve (job.rs, job/noop.rs, job/certify.rs, mounts.rs, fetch/local.rs, heads.rs, daemon.rs, work.rs)
what: A read outside a checkout (a build script's header, a path dependency, a probe of a missing file) asked the daemon to watch the directory it was in, and the no-op lane trusted a watch generation. Setting the watch up walked the tree under the directory on the daemon's loop thread: 256,216 directories under /root, and the daemon died on real projects.
cost: main's daemon unusable on any project that reads under a large directory outside its checkout
cause: two answers to one question (did what was read outside move?): a watch table with generations, and stamps; the watch cost scaled with the directory, not with what was read
workaround: removed, not patched: every outside read is a leaf with its lstat stamp, checked by `blaze_vfs::outside::holds` with the racy rule; the no-op lane sweeps one stamp per leaf and output (`noop::LastAnswer::sweep`); no `Effect::Watch` outside a checkout (a test greps the readers for one). The removed names are banned in .clippy.toml. Not compiled when written.
